tool.name: save_src_repro_bundle
tool.description:
Persist a `/src` reproduction bundle into the current Strix run directory.
Use this after analyzer/reproducer stages complete, or after `/src` precheck stops early. The bundle is stored under `strix_runs/<run_name>/src_repro/<bundle_id>/` with source report, analysis, `/src` reproduction plan snapshot, execution trace, final verdict, and manifest.

parameter.name: source_report
parameter.description: The original plain-text vulnerability report used for `/src` reproduction.

parameter.name: analysis_json
parameter.description: Analyzer output as JSON string when available. If plain text is provided, the tool will store a normalized form.

parameter.name: reproduction_plan
parameter.description: Reproducer-generated `/src` reproduction plan or step summary written to `02_reproduction_plan.txt` for compatibility.

parameter.name: execution_trace
parameter.description: Reproducer execution notes or full execution report.

parameter.name: final_verdict
parameter.description: Final `/src` conclusion text that should be written to `04_final_verdict.md`.

parameter.name: source_label
parameter.description: Input source label such as `inline` or the referenced report file path.

parameter.name: bundle_id
parameter.description: Optional deterministic bundle ID. If omitted, a new bundle ID is generated automatically.

returns.description: Response containing: success, message, bundle_id, output_dir, files, and manifest.
